H6303.name: Padon
H6303.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6303.short: Padon was an ancestor of a group of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H6355G.name: Pahath-moab
H6355G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6355G.brief: Group of returnees from Babylonian exile
H6355G.short: Pahath-moab was a group of people who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, some of whom married foreign women.

H6355I.name: Pahath-moab
H6355I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6355I.short: Pahath-moab was one of the leaders who signed the covenant of renewal during Nehemiah's time.

H6355H.name: Pahath-moab
H6355H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6355H.brief: Repairer of the wall of Jerusalem
H6355H.short: Pahath-moab was one of the people who repaired a section of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

H6396.name: Pallu
H6396.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6396.brief: Son of Reuben, ancestor of the Palluites
H6396.short: Pallu was a son of Reuben and the ancestor of the Palluite clan within the tribe of Reuben.

H6300.name: Pedahel
H6300.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6300.brief: Leader from Naphtali appointed to divide Canaan
H6300.short: Pedahel, son of Ammihud, the leader from Naphtali appointed to help divide Canaan.

H6301.name: Pedahzur
H6301.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6301.brief: Father of Gamaliel, leader from Manasseh
H6301.short: Pedahzur, father of Gamaliel, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh during the wilderness wanderings.

H6305I.name: Pedaiah
H6305I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6305I.brief: Officer over the half-tribe of Manasseh
H6305I.short: Pedaiah, son of Parosh, an officer over the half-tribe of Manasseh in King David's administration.

H6305H.name: Pedaiah
H6305H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6305H.brief: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
H6305H.short: Pedaiah, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah born during the Babylonian captivity.

H6305G.name: Pedaiah
H6305G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6305G.brief: Father of Zebidah, mother of King Jehoiakim
H6305G.short: Pedaiah, father of Zebidah, who was the mother of King Jehoiakim of Judah.

H6305L.name: Pedaiah
H6305L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6305L.brief: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
H6305L.short: Pedaiah, a Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H6305M.name: Pedaiah
H6305M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6305M.brief: Levite appointed as a treasurer by Nehemiah
H6305M.short: Pedaiah, a Levite Nehemiah appointed as a treasurer over the storehouses.

H6305J.name: Pedaiah
H6305J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6305J.brief: Father of a man who repaired Jerusalem's wall
H6305J.short: Pedaiah, father of a man who made repairs to the wall of Jerusalem in Nehemiah's time.

H6305K.name: Pedaiah
H6305K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6305K.brief: Levite who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
H6305K.short: Pedaiah, a Levite who stood with Ezra when he read the Law to the people.

H6389.name: Peleg
H6389.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6389.brief: Descendant of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
H6389.short: Peleg, a descendant of Shem and ancestor of Abraham, during whose time the earth was divided.

H6397.name: Pelonites
H6397.desc: Warriors from or of Pelon or Palet(?)
H6397.brief: Designation for two of David's mighty warriors
H6397.short: Pelonite or Paltite, a designation for two of David's mighty warriors, Helez and Ahijah.

H6369.name: Phicol
H6369.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6369.short: Phicol, the commander of the army of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied Abimelech in making treaties with Abraham and Isaac.

H6372H.name: Phinehas
H6372H.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H6372H.brief: Wicked son of Eli the priest
H6372H.short: Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest, was known for his wickedness and died in battle against the Philistines along with his brother Hophni.

H6372G.name: Phinehas
H6372G.desc: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6372G.brief: Aaron's grandson; zealous priest who opposed idolatry
H6372G.short: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron, was a priest known for his zeal in opposing idolatry and turning away God's wrath from Israel.

H6372I.name: Phinehas
H6372I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6372I.short: Phinehas, a priest who assisted in weighing and recording the gold, silver, and vessels brought to Jerusalem by Ezra.

H6394.name: Pildash
H6394.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6394.short: Pildash, one of the sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and Milcah.

H6373.name: Pinon
H6373.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6373.brief: Edomite clan chief descended from Esau
H6373.short: Pinon, one of the chiefs of Edom, descended from Esau, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H6377.name: Pithon
H6377.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H6377.short: Pithon, a descendant of King Saul, mentioned in the genealogies of the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

H6380.name: Pochereth-hazzebaim
H6380.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6380.short: Pochereth-hazzebaim, a family listed among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H6334.name: Poratha
H6334.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6334.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H6334.short: Poratha, one of the ten sons of Haman, who was hanged along with his brothers after their father's downfall.

H6318.name: Potiphar
H6318.desc: Egyptian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6318.brief: Egyptian official who bought Joseph as a slave
H6318.short: Potiphar, the Egyptian officer who purchased Joseph as a slave and later imprisoned him after false accusations by Potiphar's wife.

H6319.name: Potiphera
H6319.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6319.short: Potiphera, the priest of On (Heliopolis), whose daughter Asenath was given to Joseph as a wife by Pharaoh.

H6326.name: Puah
H6326.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6326.short: Puah, one of the two Hebrew midwives, along with Shiphrah, who defied Pharaoh's order to kill male Hebrew babies.

H6312G.name: Puah
H6312G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6312G.brief: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob
H6312G.short: Puah, also known as Puvah, was a son of Issachar and grandson of Jacob, and his descendants were called the Punites.

H6312H.name: Puah
H6312H.short: Puah, the son of Dodo from the tribe of Issachar, who's son Tola judged Israel after Abimelech.

H6316G.name: Put
H6316G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6316G.brief: Son of Ham, grandson of Noah
H6316G.short: Put was a son of Ham and grandson of Noah.

H6336.name: Puthites
H6336.brief: A clan from the tribe of Judah
H6336.short: The Puthites were a clan from the tribe of Judah.

H6317G.name: Putiel
H6317G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6317G.brief: Father-in-law of Eleazar, son of Aaron
H6317G.short: Putiel was the father-in-law of Eleazar, son of Aaron.

H6307.name: Paddan
H6307.brief: The homeland of the patriarchs in Mesopotamia
H6307.short: Paddan, also known as Paddan-aram or Aram, was the homeland of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, located in Mesopotamia.

H6364.name: Pi-beseth
H6364.brief: An Egyptian city mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
H6364.short: Pi-beseth was an Egyptian city that Ezekiel prophesied would experience God's judgment along with other cities in Egypt.

H6367.name: Pi-hahiroth
H6367.brief: A place near the Red Sea crossing
H6367.short: Pi-hahiroth was a location near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped before crossing the sea during the Exodus from Egypt.

H6376.name: Pishon
H6376.brief: A river flowing from Eden, encircling Havilah
H6376.short: Pishon was one of the four rivers that flowed from the river in the Garden of Eden, encircling the land of Havilah, which was known for its gold, bdellium, and onyx.

H6325.name: Punon
H6325.brief: A stopping place for the Israelites in the wilderness
H6325.short: Punon was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings, located between Zalmonah and Oboth.

H6332.name: Purim
H6332.brief: Jewish festival commemorating the events in the book of Esther
H6332.short: Purim is the Jewish festival celebrating the deliverance of the Jews from Haman's plot to destroy them, as recorded in the book of Esther (<ref="Esther 9:26-32">Esther 9:26-32</ref>).
